jamal_support: Heads up — customer encountered strict JSON enforcement but got an HTML login page instead of a JSON error. Repro + logs below, escalating to eng.

jamal_support: Repro steps (minimal):
```
curl -i \
  -H "Accept: application/json; profile=urn:customer:response" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EXPIRED_TOKEN>" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?response_format=structured&strict=true"
```
Response seen at edge: (this is the failure path the customer hit)
```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
<html>...login redirect page from auth proxy...</html>
```
Client then tries to parse body as JSON -> parse error / invalid JSON complaint.

ingrid_engineer: Can you share the request_id from the edge logs and whether any custom Accept/profile headers were present?

jamal_support: request_id=req_01FZ9KQ2XAN
Edge log snippet:
```
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] req_01FZ9KQ2XAN auth: token expired -> upstream returned 401 HTML
[2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] req_01FZ9KQ2XAN response: Content-Type=text/html; body-length=412
```

alex_m: Likely cause: our auth gateway returns an HTML login page for expired tokens. When the client requested strict/structured output we still passed through HTML — client tries to parse -> "invalid JSON". We should normalize error responses for structured-mode requests.

sophia_ops: Short-term workaround for customer: rotate the token (fixes auth), or set `Accept: */*` and handle non-JSON, or call with `strict=false` / remove `response_format=structured` until gateway patch. Confirmed they recovered after token rotation.

ingrid_engineer: Long-term fix: file an infra ticket to ensure gateway returns JSON error payloads when `response_format=structured` or `strict=true` is present (force Content-Type: application/problem+json or application/json and a small structured error body). Also add telemetry to log when content-type != application/json for these requests.

jamal_support: Customer rotated token and their integration recovered. Leaving ticket open until gateway change. Added repro curl + logs above. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Created INFRA-3247 (priority=P2) assigned to @ingrid_engineer
